lessons.title: What Do We Do at the Seaside?
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to describe an activity people do at the seaside.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss any seaside visits children have had.
lessons.main_activity: Discuss seaside activities (building sandcastles, paddling, eating ice cream) using pictures.
key_questions: What do people do at the seaside?
Have you been to the seaside?

differentiation.extension: Describe a seaside memory in detail

lessons.assessment_notes: Note vocabulary and personal experience sharing — evidence for UTW.2.
lessons.home_link: Talk about a seaside memory with your family.

lessons.title: Story Time: 'Katie Morag Delivers the Mail' or a Seaside Story
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to describe the seaside/island setting of the story.
lessons.main_activity: Read a seaside/island themed story, discussing the setting and what happens there.
lessons.assessment_notes: Note comprehension of setting — evidence for LIT.1.
lessons.plenary: Discuss favourite part of the story.
lessons.home_link: Retell the story to someone at home.

lessons.title: Counting Shells
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to count shells accurately up to 10+.
lessons.starter_activity: Count a group of shell pictures together.
lessons.main_activity: Children count and sort shell counters into groups by size or type, recording totals.
key_questions: Can you count them again to check?
lessons.assessment_notes: Record counting accuracy — evidence for MATHS.1.
lessons.home_link: Count shells or small objects at home together.

lessons.title: Where Does Sand Come From?
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to describe simply that sand is made of tiny pieces of broken rock and shell.
lessons.starter_activity: Feel sand (real or in a tray) and look closely with a magnifying glass.
lessons.main_activity: Discuss that sand is made from tiny broken pieces of rock and shell, worn down by the sea over a long time.
key_questions: What do you notice when you look closely at sand?
Where do you think sand comes from?

differentiation.extension: Explain how sand forms over time

lessons.assessment_notes: Note investigative observation and early geological understanding — evidence for UTW.3.
lessons.plenary: Recap what sand is made of.
lessons.home_link: Look closely at sand or soil together at home.

lessons.title: Writing a Postcard from the Seaside
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to attempt to write a simple postcard message.
lessons.main_activity: Children design and attempt to write a simple postcard message (e.g. 'I like the beach') using known phonics sounds.

differentiation.extension: Independent phonetic attempt at a short sentence

lessons.assessment_notes: Note purposeful writing attempt — evidence for LIT.3.
lessons.home_link: Write a postcard message to a family member.

lessons.title: Sorting Shells by Size and Shape
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to sort shells using more than one criterion.
lessons.starter_activity: Look at a mixed pile of different shells.
lessons.main_activity: Children sort shells by size (big/small) and then re-sort by shape (spiral, flat), discussing their choices.
resources_needed: Assorted shells or shell picture cards
key_questions: Can you sort them a different way?

differentiation.extension: Sort by 2+ criteria and explain reasoning

lessons.assessment_notes: Note sorting/classifying skill — evidence for MATHS.2.
lessons.home_link: Sort shells or small objects at home by size or shape.

lessons.title: Building Sandcastles: What Makes Sand Stick Together?
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to observe that wet sand holds shape better than dry sand.
lessons.starter_activity: Predict whether wet or dry sand will build a better sandcastle.
lessons.main_activity: (Using a sand/water tray) children test building with wet vs dry sand, observing which holds its shape.
resources_needed: Sand and water tray, small buckets/moulds
key_questions: Why do you think that happened?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note investigative observation and early reasoning — evidence for UTW.3.
lessons.plenary: Recap what makes the best sandcastle sand.
lessons.home_link: Build with sand (wet and dry) at home or at the beach if possible.

lessons.title: Retelling the Seaside Story
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to retell the story's key events in sequence.
lessons.main_activity: Using picture cards, children retell the story sequence using sequencing words.
lessons.assessment_notes: Note sequencing and retelling ability — evidence for LIT.1/CL.2.
lessons.plenary: One group retells to the class.
lessons.home_link: Retell the story to someone at home.

lessons.title: Measuring Sandcastle Heights
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to measure and compare sandcastle heights using non-standard units.
lessons.main_activity: Children build small sandcastles and measure their height using linking cubes, comparing with a partner.
lessons.assessment_notes: Note measurement and comparison skill — evidence for MATHS.2.
lessons.home_link: Measure a sandcastle or tower built at home.

lessons.title: Rockpool Creatures
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to name a creature found in a rockpool.
lessons.starter_activity: Look at pictures of rockpool creatures.
lessons.main_activity: Discuss creatures found in rockpools at the seaside (crabs, starfish, anemones), noting where they hide.
lessons.assessment_notes: Note vocabulary and habitat understanding — evidence for UTW.3.
lessons.home_link: Look up rockpool creatures together at home.

lessons.title: Phonics: Reading Seaside Words
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to blend and read simple seaside-themed words.
lessons.main_activity: Phonics stations reading seaside-themed word cards and simple sentences (e.g. 'the sun is hot').

differentiation.support: Read simple CVC words with support

lessons.assessment_notes: Note phonics application to themed vocabulary — evidence for LIT.2.
lessons.plenary: Celebrate reading progress with a themed reading game.
lessons.home_link: Practise reading seaside words over the week.

lessons.title: Maths Progress Check: Full Year Number Skills
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to demonstrate their number skills built across the whole year.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the year's key number learning.
lessons.main_activity: Mixed assessment activity covering counting, number bonds, and doubling built across the year, celebrating progress.
key_questions: How confident do you feel with numbers now?
What are you most proud of?

differentiation.extension: Demonstrate skills independently and help a peer

lessons.assessment_notes: Record end-of-year number skills summary for each child — evidence for MATHS.1.
lessons.plenary: Celebrate everyone's number progress this year.

lessons.title: Seaside Holidays Recap Display
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to summarise key facts about the seaside learned this week.
lessons.main_activity: Contribute to a class 'Seaside Holidays' display summarising activities, sand, and rockpool creatures.
key_questions: What have we learned about the seaside?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note synthesis of the week's learning — evidence for UTW.3/UTW.2.
lessons.home_link: Share what you learned about the seaside with your family.

lessons.title: Seaside Quiz Game
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to answer recall questions about the seaside learned this week.
lessons.main_activity: Quiz-style game asking questions about seaside activities, sand, and rockpool creatures from the week.
key_questions: What creature might you find in a rockpool?
lessons.assessment_notes: Assess recall and comprehension — evidence for LIT.1/CL.1.
lessons.home_link: Quiz your family on seaside facts learned this week.

lessons.title: Maths Review: Counting, Sorting, Measuring
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to apply counting, sorting, and measuring skills learned this week.
lessons.main_activity: Rotate through 3 stations: counting shells, sorting shells by size/shape, measuring sandcastle heights.
key_questions: Which group does this belong to?
lessons.plenary: Class recap game combining all three skills.
lessons.home_link: Continue practising sorting and measuring over the weekend.
